result.summary: M4 Pro 24GB provider-prebeta hardware-profile and verifier acceptance passed on Pearl production. The provider submitted replacement hardware evidence, received dual-control hardware trust, verified through stats-hardware-verifier, remained route-eligible, and served a public authenticated buyer smoke request for the expected Llama model. This artifact promotes only SPEC-033-R001; strict-gate, referral, broader autotune, buyer-money, and payout-registration rows remain outside this claim.

steps.assertion: The same-Mac replacement provider entered through the current provider-prebeta posture: referral activation was not required for this cohort claim, and hardware trust was handled through dual-control operator approval before verifier promotion.

The provider launched as provider-cli v1.8.88 on the redacted Apple M4 Pro 24GB Mac, produced a new stable provider identity fingerprint, and reported hardware profile fields through the CLI hello path.
Pearl admitted the same redacted provider identity, assigned a coordinator session, marked bearer authentication valid, and reported the provider ready and routing-eligible after trust verification.
The provider selected mlx-community/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-4bit through the current autotune catalog row, with catalog identity, model hash, and weights manifest digest captured from Pearl pool state.

Hardware verifier job 24 for the same redacted provider identity moved from waiting_trust to verified after dual-control hardware trust, with decision_reason hardware-verifier.v2:verified_trusted_hardware and provider_hardware_profiles.verified=true.

After verifier success, Pearl pool state showed the provider ready, routing_eligible=true, auth_state=bearer_validated, hash_status=hash_verified, encrypted_leg=true, slots_free=1, and WS tunneled inference active.

A public authenticated request through https://api.malibu.tech/v1/chat/completions returned HTTP 200 for mlx-community/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-4bit, and the buyer-visible provider attribution plus coordinator route snapshot both hashed to the newly admitted 24GB provider.

The artifact redacts provider IDs, session IDs, hostnames, endpoint URLs, account IDs, operator credentials, demo token material, and local account names while preserving stable SHA-256 fingerprints for verifier, pool, route, and buyer-smoke correlation.
